description: This file contains integration tests for the delete article feature in an ASP.NET Core application, verifying deletion of articles with and without associated tags and comments.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying deletion of articles, including cases with tags and comments, using xUnit framework.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Tests that deleting an article without tags or comments results in its removal from the database.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Tests that deleting an article with associated tags removes the article successfully.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Tests that deleting an article with associated comments removes the article and its comments from the database.
